title: Profile
description: <.jad>/profiles/<category>/<name>.json. The profile name is the file name. A profile picks a prompt, the models it may use, one toolset and setting overrides.

models.description: Narrows the models. Items: "<category>" for a whole folder, "<category>/<name>" for one file, or "*". A missing key offers every model; [] offers none. An item that matches no model is a load error.

model_default.description: Model used when a request names none, written <category>/<name>, for example "openai/gpt-deep". Must be one of the profile's models. Without it, the first of them (by ID) is used.

toolset.description: The toolset this profile uses, written <category>/<name> under tools/, for example "coding/full". Any toolset may be used. Without it the profile has no native tool and no MCP tool.

tools.description: The tools.allow filter of the profile, unchanged: which registered tools the model sees.

settings.description: Overrides of the setting keys listed in propertyNames. Objects merge key by key with the level above; arrays and scalars replace it. Each value follows the same key in setting.schema.json.

cwd.description: Working directory of runs. Absolute path (or ~). Defaults, session and profile may all set it; the nearer level wins (profile, then session, then root defaults). The session's top-level cwd beats its settings.cwd.

env_file.description: Dotenv file for the toolset's bash, process and exec when they name no env_file of their own. A relative path is relative to the folder of the root setting.json. Defaults, session and profile may all set it; the nearer level wins. A tool the toolset lacks is not added.

tool_storage_dir.description: Folder that holds the tool storage (bash spill, memory, tasks, fetch, processes, sub-agent runs, write/edit backups), as <folder>/<session>/<category>/<name>/tools. A relative path is relative to the session cwd, so the file tools reach it with no extra path rule; the default is .jad/state. An absolute path outside the cwd needs tools.native.read.paths to allow it. The transcript and staging stay in the root state folder. Defaults, session and profile may all set it; the nearer level wins.
